title: A World That Changes: A Planning Scene With a Version, Objects That Grow Less Certain as They Age, a Part in the Gripper, and Plans That Know They Are Stale

artifact.note: a planning scene that changes: objects (spheres and boxes) added, moved and removed by identifier, each change raising a version; a time of last seen and a speed it may have moved at, so that an object not seen for a while is treated as bigger by the distance it could have moved (up to a cap); the scene as the collision model of 30-01 at a time; a test whether a plan made at one version is stale at another; and a part held in the gripper, which makes the arm longer and fatter at its tool
